name: All decision classes included
requirement: Export contains positive, no-action, legal-stop, warning and blocked decisions.

name: Persisted trace
requirement: Report uses stored run trace, not reconstructed current state.

name: Raw and normalised inputs
requirement: Every used input carries both plus unit.

name: Evidence states
requirement: Every input is MEASURED/DERIVED/IRISH_MODEL/IRISH_DEFAULT/INSUFFICIENT.

name: Defaults visible
requirement: Defaults are explicit and never labelled measured.

name: Ordered formula trace
requirement: Every numeric transformation appears in ordered steps.

name: Rounding visible
requirement: Boundary-affecting rounding rules are disclosed.

name: Complete legal checks
requirement: Applicable checks include PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE.

name: Hard fail suppresses action
requirement: A legal FAIL cannot coexist with contradictory action.

name: Source register integrity
requirement: Every source ID resolves to source register.

name: Source location
requirement: Table/page/section captured where available.

name: Historical immutability
requirement: Changing data creates a new run.

name: Ruleset versioning
requirement: Historical run keeps historical rules; new run uses current.

name: Peer review separate
requirement: Reviewer action does not mutate calculation.

name: Blocked inputs visible
requirement: Blocked outputs list missing evidence and resolution.

name: Alternative rejection
requirement: Rejected alternatives say why.

name: LLM non-authoritative
requirement: Narrative cannot add/change calculations.

name: Narrative consistency
requirement: Narrative contradiction with trace fails validation.

name: Trace SHA-256
requirement: Each run has canonical trace fingerprint.

name: Hash sensitivity
requirement: Changing a normalised input/rule/model/code version changes hash.

name: CSV referential integrity
requirement: All child rows join to valid run/recommendation IDs.

name: JSON schema validity
requirement: Machine trace validates against schema.

name: Report filters
requirement: UI supports evidence/reviewer/decision/source filters.

name: Run comparison
requirement: UI shows changed inputs/rules and output delta.
